name: CoolerControl
description: CoolerControl is a Linux cooling control and monitoring daemon with a built-in Web UI. It supports hwmon/sysfs devices, liquidctl hardware, GPU monitoring, profiles, alerts and automatic fan control.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent CoolerControl configuration, profiles, alerts, credentials and backups.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent CoolerControl runtime data, plugins and session state.

paths.name: Hardware Monitoring
paths.description: Provides hardware monitoring sensors to CoolerControl. Read-only access is sufficient for detection and monitoring.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: CoolerControl Web UI and REST API.
